offline.scope: Official 0.0.20 Linux x64 loopback lifecycle on the exact runtime digest; same-run publication evidence is still required.

lifecycle.scope: Actual official 0.0.20 client and exact-runtime HTTP MCP on macOS arm64 in a bounded existing-Tunnel Cloud window, with an independent test Store; normal client and Runtime shutdown, both test Sessions detached, ownership released and the original stdio service restored and health checked.

cloud.scope: One existing Cloud Tunnel, two independent test MCP endpoints, three messages and two ACKs. ChatGPT sent a request; the Pi test endpoint created an explicitly associated reply; ChatGPT reported finding and reading it via Cloud.
cloud.cleanupMeaning: Bounded normal stop and restoration completed before the deadline; the existing hardStopCleanup schema field does not claim forced-kill recovery.
cloud.requestCorrelation: Cloud tool results were relayed by the user and corroborated against the isolated Store's receipts and message association; no raw remote transcript or global per-tool wire-request join was retained.
cloud.schemaRefresh: User reported that after ChatGPT client restart and service refresh, ping was reachable and the exposed ce_send Schema included replyTo. No ChatGPT replyTo send was performed after that refresh.

qualification.artifactScope: The Cloud Runtime was built from the clean fixed source export used for the canonical archive, not from an installed production package.

limitations: Manual Cloud covers macOS arm64, Node 24.21.0 and node-sqlite with the official 0.0.20 client and one existing Tunnel; other platforms and a real namespaced Cloud identity are NOT_VERIFIED.
The Pi test peer was a fixed-candidate MCP Runtime driven by the operator, not the production Pi Session; automatic intake, model task execution and desktop submission are NOT_VERIFIED.

ChatGPT received and ACKed a Pi message and sent an independent request; Pi used replyTo and ChatGPT queried and read the associated reply. ChatGPT-originated replyTo sending remains NOT_VERIFIED after the reported Schema refresh.
ACK records reception only; forced-kill recovery, unknown-result replay, exactly-once business completion and remote revoke or timeout scenarios are NOT_VERIFIED.
Remote observations were relayed by the user and corroborated by durable local evidence, without a raw remote transcript or global per-tool wire-request join.
The restored production service is running with all three startup attempts consumed; no budget reset was performed.
A fresh official-client offline result from the same authorized publication workflow run remains mandatory.
